# Mailroom-Corpus-EDA: appendix {.page-title}

[Published v9.2 tables · configuration, provenance, sources and licences]{.kicker}

These tables support the [Mailroom-Corpus-EDA case study](../mailroom-corpus-eda.qmd). They describe the published `v9.2` revision of [mailroom-dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lucius-Morningstar/mailroom-dataset/tree/v9.2) and come from its dataset card. No documents or participant-level records are reproduced here.

## Published configurations

| Configuration | Rows | Contents |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `default` | 3,302 | Four columns only: filename, document text, prompt, metadata. No label column. |
| `ground_truth` | 3,302 | Labels, identity hashes, evaluation contract and matter grouping, joined on filename. |
| `bundles` | 50 | Synthetic bundle families over real anchors, flagged as constructed. |
| `streams` | 62 | Interleaved ingress stream with distractors. |
| `fixtures` | 32 | Recovery and adversarial fixtures. |

`ground_truth` carries 35 top-level columns; the nested `gt_fields` object holds 34 keys, 32 scalar and two matter lists.

## Sources and licences

| Class | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contract | CUAD v1 (509) plus SEC EDGAR EX-10 exhibits (91) | CC BY 4.0; US public domain |
| Merger agreement | MAUD v1, Zenodo 7500064 | CC BY 4.0 |
| Corporate record | SEC EDGAR S-1 and 8-K exhibits | US public domain |
| Correspondence | Deduplicated Enron corpus, 247,523-row pool | Research use; contains real named-individual PII |
| Insurance claim | CMS DE-SynPUF, GNOTHEIA, BDR and INSURBIAS narratives | Apache-2.0, MIT, CC BY 4.0 |

These are the component terms. Citing the combined corpus does not replace them; see [Cite the dataset](../mailroom-corpus-eda.qmd#dataset-citation).

## How labels were produced

| Annotation method | Rows |
| --- | ---: |
| Synthetic | 1,100 |
| Source-native | 661 |
| Heuristic | 646 |
| LLM zero-shot | 637 |
| Verified join | 162 |
| Human annotated | 96 |

Every label-bearing field also carries a presence code, so an empty value is never ambiguous:

| Presence code | Fields | Share |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Populated | 22,591 | 34.2% |
| Not applicable | 41,338 | 62.6% |
| Schema-documented absence | 2,020 | 3.1% |
| Pending annotation | 91 | 0.1% |

No field is an undocumented gap. The 91 pending entries are the SEC EDGAR EX-10 contracts, whose CUAD clause labels wait on a separate annotation pass.

## Split and held-out test

The reproducible split puts a document in the test set when the MD5 of its filename, modulo 10, is zero. That gives 323 test documents and 2,979 for training and validation, split 2,680 / 299 at 90/10 and stratified by document type with seed 42. The split is an evaluation partition, not a claim that the corpus was designed as a training set.

## Scope

::: {.caveat}
**Counts belong to one published revision.** These tables describe `v9.2`. A later rebuild would change them, so pin the revision when reproducing results. Ten strata have no test documents, and the largest class is 7.2 times the smallest, so per-stratum results need their own denominators.
:::

:::
